frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The risk-neutral measure Q is the equivalent probability measure under which discounted tradable-asset prices are martingales; under Q every asset drifts at the risk-free rate, so the no-arbitrage price equals the discounted expected payoff. Choosing a numeraire other than the bank account (share, T-bond) gives an equivalent measure with the same martingale-pricing logic.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Risk-Neutral Measure and Numeraire Change
